title: Page-reading accuracy
detail: Character error rate 0.00% on clean pages and 0.00% on pages degraded like phone photos (tilt, blur, dim light, noise). On deliberately hard photos (6-8° tilt, heavy blur, dim and uneven light, strong JPEG compression) it was 0.02%. Lower is better. Ground truth is the OpenStax source text.
dataset: OpenStax pages rendered as images, clean and phone-photo-degraded
method: jiwer character error rate vs source text, after normalising quotes and whitespace
